resolution.question: Will Bramblewick Studios send Elin Bjork any decision, offer or rejection, within the two weeks their art director promised at the end of her final interview?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Bramblewick Studios sent Elin Bjork a decision, offer, or rejection (via any communication channel) before 2026-10-23T16:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
